searchText: Hey folks can we maybe stop using fully deterministic signatures? Maybe we can make EIP. There was another CVE which leaks private keys in a popular JS lib which eth deps used. Hedged signatures solve this. https://paulmillr.com/posts/deterministic-signatures/

excerpts.author: paulmillr
excerpts.content:
Hey folks can we maybe stop using fully deterministic signatures? Maybe we can make EIP.

There was another CVE which leaks private keys in a popular JS lib which eth deps used. Hedged signatures solve this.

https://paulmillr.com/posts/deterministic-signatures/
